content: Since none of the datasets from previous works have been published, we decide to build a new one. We randomly collect INLINEFORM0 cases from China Judgments Online, among which INLINEFORM1 cases are for training, INLINEFORM2 each for validation and testing. Among the original cases, INLINEFORM3 are granted divorce and others not. There are INLINEFORM4 valid pleas in total, with INLINEFORM5 supported and INLINEFORM6 rejected. Note that, if the divorce plea in a case is not granted, the other pleas of this case will not be considered by the judge. Case materials are all natural language sentences, with averagely INLINEFORM7 tokens per fact description and INLINEFORM8 per plea. There are 62 relevant law articles in total, each with INLINEFORM9 tokens averagely. Note that the case documents include special typographical signals, making it easy to extract labeled data with regular expression.
